$comment: MapIO parity benchmark, reconstructed from the MapIO paper (arXiv:2412.00946) and this repo only. Sources per case: 'formative' = §3.1 questionnaire; 'benchmark' = named §4.2/§4.3 examples; 'study' = §5.3 user-study tasks; 'template' = res/prompt_en.yaml few-shot pattern re-instantiated with a DIFFERENT POI (the yaml POIs are inside the system prompt, so testing them verbatim would be train-on-test). Grading follows the paper's 6 classes: deceptively_wrong, not_replying, blatantly_wrong, partial_incomplete, correct_not_optimal, correct. Categories follow Brock et al.: landmark / route / survey. The GPT-4o iteration-8 bar on the New York map: 94.74% correct + 5.26% correct_not_optimal.
$position_spec: position is null, or one of: {"poi": name} (finger on that POI), {"street": name} (midpoint of the street's middle edge), {"intersection": [streetA, streetB]} (shared node), {"node_index": N}. Multi-turn cases use 'turns', each turn may carry its own position.

cases.utterance: Give me an overall description of the map.
cases.grading_notes: Should describe the Empire State Building neighborhood in Midtown Manhattan: a street grid (31 streets: numbered W/E 27th-40th cross streets plus avenues incl. 5th, 6th, 7th, Madison, Park, Broadway), with ~50 POIs (restaurants, banks, libraries, the Empire State Building). Must not invent features.

cases.utterance: What can I find on this map?
cases.grading_notes: Streets and points of interest: restaurants/cafes (Korean, Chinese, Italian...), banks (Bank of America, Chase, Wells Fargo...), libraries (Science Industry and Business Library, Stavros Niarchos, Morgan Library), the Empire State Building, pubs, a spa. Grounded in actual POI list, not invented.

cases.utterance: Tell me if there are stairs at some point on the road.
cases.grading_notes: Yes. 24 of 31 streets have at least one segment with stairs, incl. 5th Avenue, 6th Avenue, 7th Avenue, Broadway, Madison Avenue, Park Avenue and most numbered streets. Correct = affirms and names at least some affected streets; blatantly_wrong = denies.

cases.utterance: Tell me the roads parallel to this one.
cases.grading_notes: Finger is on West 35th Street. Parallel roads: the other numbered W/E streets, most immediately West 34th Street and West 36th Street. Paper's expected answer named the two adjacent parallel roads.

cases.utterance: How can I come here from Solle Spa?
cases.grading_notes: GPT-4o initially failed this one (wrong accessibility info, iteration 5). Expected: directions from Solle Spa to the 5th Ave / W 35th St intersection along real streets, or a guide_to_destination call. Street names must exist and the path must be plausible on the graph.

cases.utterance: How far is Solle Spa on foot?
cases.grading_notes: GPT-4o initially miscalculated this (iteration 5); fixed by the get_distance tool. Correct = distance consistent with the get_distance_to_point_of_interest tool result (feet, optionally converted to walking minutes). Grade against the tool output in the transcript.

Template of yaml 'Where is McDonald's?'. Expected: location description from get_point_of_interest_details (street + between which intersections), then offer guidance (fly-me-there or street-by-street) per the yaml example.

Details from get_point_of_interest_details: Chinese restaurant, street, nearest intersections, hours/accessibility if present. No invented facts (the LLM may know the real Cafe China — answers must come from the map data).

cases.utterance: What is the nearest intersection to the Empire State Building?
cases.grading_notes: Template of yaml nearest-intersection example. Grade against the POI's edge/location_description (on 5th Avenue between W 33rd and W 34th).

cases.utterance: Where is Starbucks located relative to the Empire State Building?
cases.grading_notes: Template of yaml relative-location example. Expected: both POIs' locations and a correct relative direction/distance between them (verify with coords in transcript).

Template of yaml nearest-restaurant example. Expected: get_distance_to_point_of_interest over candidate restaurants, then the nearest named. Verify against tool results in the transcript. Korean restaurants cluster on W 32nd (BCD Tofu House, Gammeeok...).

cases.utterance: How can I get to the nearest bank?
cases.grading_notes: Template of yaml nearest-restaurant-directions example. Expected: distance calls over banks (Bank of America, Bank of Hope, Chase, Citizens, Valley, Wells Fargo), nearest chosen, then guide_to_point_of_interest with mode inferred or clarification requested ('how can I get to' = street-by-street per yaml).

cases.utterance: Are there roadworks on this street?
cases.grading_notes: Yaml roadworks example, position on W 38th. Ground truth: West 38th Street has at least one segment with roadwork. Correct = yes (ideally locating the segment).
Yaml walklight example. Node 4 has walk_light=true (33 of 69 nodes do). Correct = yes, ideally with the duration from node features.

cases.utterance: Is there any restaurant open at 10 PM?
cases.grading_notes: Yaml open-at-10PM example (same wording, different map than yaml's implied one). Grade against opening_hours of the restaurant POIs in the transcript/model. Must consider restaurants broadly, not just one.

cases.utterance: Guide me to the Empire State Building.
cases.grading_notes: 'Guide me' = fly-me-there per the prompt's own convention. Expected: guide_to_point_of_interest with street_by_street=false, then confirmation that guidance/navigation mode is enabled.

cases.utterance: Navigate me to Bank of America.
cases.grading_notes: 'Navigate me' = street-by-street per the prompt's own convention. Expected: guide_to_point_of_interest with street_by_street=true, then confirmation.

cases.utterance: Is there a Walmart on this map?
cases.grading_notes: Hallucination probe (paper iteration 1 failure mode: fabricating unknown POIs). Ground truth: no Walmart. Correct = clean denial, per the base instruction to acknowledge missing information.

cases.$comment: The §5.3 user-study tasks 2-10 as one continuous conversation, as in the study (task 1, free exploration, is omitted). Bookmarking in t3 must survive to t9. Grade each turn separately.

turns.utterance: I will be staying at the Sheraton Commander Grand Lake hotel. Is this hotel on the map?
turns.grading_notes: Yes; on Mitchell Street. Should confirm presence and ideally locate it.

turns.utterance: Is there free Wi-Fi at the hotel?
turns.grading_notes: Yes: facilities.internet_access = 'free Wi-Fi'. Must come from POI details, not a guess.

turns.utterance: Since the hotel has a long name, please remember it as 'my hotel'.
turns.grading_notes: Should acknowledge the bookmark. Paper notes GPT-4o sometimes refused this as 'storing personal information' (P15, P19) - that counts as not_replying.

turns.utterance: I want to find a nice restaurant for a late evening dinner with friends. Is there an Italian restaurant?
turns.grading_notes: Yes: The Italian Table, on Revere Avenue. Should name it.

turns.utterance: Is the restaurant open at 10 PM?
turns.grading_notes: Yes: Mo-Su 7:00 AM - 11:00 PM, so open at 10 PM (closes at 11 PM). Follow-up coreference: 'the restaurant' = The Italian Table from t5.

turns.utterance: How long would it take me to walk there from my hotel?
turns.grading_notes: Uses both the bookmark ('my hotel' = Sheraton) and coreference ('there' = The Italian Table). Correct = distance from tool call converted to a plausible walking time; verify against the tool result in the transcript.

turns.utterance: I have decided to go by taxi instead. Help me point to the restaurant on the map.
turns.grading_notes: Fly-me-there guidance to The Italian Table: guide_to_point_of_interest with street_by_street=false ('help me point/locate' = fly-me-there).

turns.utterance: What entertainment options are near the restaurant?
turns.grading_notes: Finger now at The Italian Table (per study task 8-9 sequence). Expected: nearby entertainment - Starlight Cinema is on the same street (Revere Avenue); Pixel Arcade and The Plaza Cinema exist elsewhere on the map. Grade against get_nearby_points_of_interest output.

turns.utterance: After dinner I want to go back to my hotel. Navigate me there.
turns.grading_notes: Uses the bookmark again. 'Navigate me' = street-by-street: guide_to_point_of_interest to Sheraton Commander Grand Lake Hotel with street_by_street=true.
